messages:
nora: Drafting a short multi-region provisioning checklist for Dedicated Capacity. tossing it in a PR shortly. want to capture region affinity, routing fallback, and billing note.
jas: nice. can we include an explicit example for 'reserved-pool' creation that shows labels and region_hint? customers keep asking how to pin to us-west1.
michael: yea add `region_hint: us-west1` example. also remind that cross-region failover costs egress.
nora: tentative snippet for examples/yaml/multi-region.yml: ```yaml
- name: payments-reserved
  tier: reserved
  region_hint: us-west1
  isolation_labels: {team: payments, env: prod}
  scale_mode: autoscale
``` will add to PR body
tara: small UX note: the Console currently shows region as 'primary region' not 'region_hint' so add mapping note `region_hint -> primary region in UI`
jas: add a migration hint for folks using legacy field `region` in terraform -> `region_hint` in new schema. small CLI example?
nora: added CLI snippet in PR: `rwctl capacity create --name payments-reserved --tier reserved --region-hint us-west1 --labels team=payments,env=prod`
ci-bot: docs preview queued for PR #2467 - checks: snippets-lint, linkcheck
michael: propose a short table in the checklist: scenarios where you should choose dedicated reserved vs dedicated bursty (cost vs latency predictability). i can draft a one-paragraph blurb.
tara: also include a 1-liner about routing policy precedence: "region affinity > tier priority > fallback routing" small example: if us-west primary is down, requests route to nearest compatible region to meet SLOs.
jas: can we add a short bit about per-tenant isolation density? e.g., "prefer grouping small tenants into shared pools rather than individual tenant pools unless strict isolation required"
nora: added that under 'labeling best practices' with example: `isolation_labels: {team: foo}` and a warning about very high cardinality.
nora: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2467 - dropping the checklist and snippets there.
ci-bot: snippets-lint failed: examples/yaml/multi-region.yml - YAML indentation warning at line 3
jas: small fix pushed to PR to adjust indentation
ci-bot: snippets-lint passed; linkcheck found one external anchor pointing to /handbook/billing which moved.
michael: updated reference to /handbook/finops/billing-regions and added note about egress costs.
tara: last nit: replace phrase 'failover' with 'regional fallback' in checklist to keep tone neutral.
nora: applied wording change, queued for merge after CI green. merging if no objections in 30m.
jas: 👍 good to me
michael: looks good, approving
ci-bot: all checks passed for PR #2467
_meta: created_by: nora; context: docs PR for multi-region dedicated provisioning checklist, snippet examples, region_hint and labeling best-practices
